title: Does It Fit?
shortDescription: Paste a product (link, photo, or name), say what you need it for, and get a yes / maybe / no with a short reason.
description: Next.js app that answers one question: will this product actually meet my need? You give a product and a free-text need. It returns a verdict, a 0-100 fit score, a short reason, and pros/cons columns. Gemini runs behind a server route.
